{{Quote|As Article 17 of Ziost Convention states, an Imperial Admiral is justified in destroying Imperial targets at risk of falling into enemy hands.|Harridax Kirill|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Ziost Convention''' was a set of military guidelines followed by the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Article 17 was an element of the Convention that allowed an Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] to destroy Imperial targets that were at risk in falling into enemy hands.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], an official declaration of war was declared against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At the time, the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]] decided to envoke Article 17 to destroy the Imperial treasury ship [[King's Ransom (treasury ship)|''King's Ransom'']] rather than allow it to fall into the hands of a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]].
